shortDescription: Maruti Suzuki NSE:MARUTI reported a rise in monthly sales on Tuesday as India's top automaker benefited from domestic demand ahead of the festive season.The company posted a monthly total sales of 219,220 units compared with 180,683 units in the year-ago period.
